_comment: One plain line per skill for the website, grouped. A skill missing here still appears: the generator falls back to the first sentence of its SKILL.md description under 'More'.

web-read: Reads open web pages and web searches, and files what it found with the source.
x-read: Reads public X posts by link, many at once. No login.
scrapling: Reads pages that refuse a normal fetch: 403s, JavaScript-only pages.
agent-reach: Reads posts that need a login on X, Reddit, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram and YouTube. Sign in with a spare account, never your real one.
agent-web-fetch: Picks the right reader when a page won't open, and says so when nothing can reach it.
chrome-tools: Works in pages you're already signed in to, through your own browser.
last30days: What people said about a topic in the last 30 days, across eight platforms.
video-watcher: A timestamped transcript of any video, made on your own computer. Optional shot-by-shot breakdown.
channel-mine: Reads a whole YouTube channel or podcast back catalog and sorts it by theme.
media-tools: Converts, trims, shrinks and resizes video, audio and image files. Makes a GIF or pulls the audio out.
markitdown: Turns Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, HTML and Outlook files into plain text with a note of where each came from.
document-builder: Turns your notes into a Word, PDF or PowerPoint file, or a table into a file a spreadsheet can open.
summarize: Turns a long document, folder or thread into a short brief: decisions, open items and dates.
image-search: Finds free stock photos on Pexels, Unsplash and Pixabay and records the license for each.
gallery-dl: Pulls full-size images from galleries and social pages you own.
loc-dl: Downloads Library of Congress images with their rights statement attached.
client-asset-harvester: Collects every image from an existing website, with its details and the logo picked out.
photo-organizer: Renames your photos by the date taken, sets duplicates aside and sorts them by month. Nothing deleted, nothing uploaded.
deep-research: Breaks a question into parts, searches from several angles, checks claims against each other, and writes a sourced brief.
notebooklm-research: Studies a pile of sources, even YouTube links, in Google NotebookLM.
meeting-prep: One page on a person or company before a call: who they are, what they want, and three questions to ask.
voice-extractor: Learns how you write from emails and notes you wrote, so what it writes sounds like you.
writer: Writes everyday emails, replies, notes and thank-yous in your voice.
social-copywriter: Posts and captions for nine platforms, in your voice. Drafts only. It never posts.
resume-and-letter: Fits your resume to a job posting, writes the cover letter, and writes letters that need a result: a dispute, a landlord, a refund.
explain-this: Explains a contract, bill, medical letter or notice in plain words, with the dates and three things to do.
paperwork: Reads a scan or photo of a letter, bill or form, names it, files it, and pulls out the dates that matter.
money-log: Turns a bank or card export into a monthly summary by category and a list of repeat charges. No bank connection.
trip-plan: Turns booking confirmations into one itinerary in date order, plus a list of what's still not booked.
gap-finder: Notices when a task has no tool, says so, and offers to build one, find one, or do it by hand.
tool-vetting: Before you install a tool you saw online, checks what it really is and whether you already have something that does the job.
workspace-diff: Compares a course or method you found with your workspace and lists what it would change. Changes nothing without your yes.
workspace-audit: Checks that the files telling Claude where things are still match your folders. Moves nothing without your yes.
doctor: Checks every tool and sign-in the workspace needs, and puts back only what's missing.
undo: Keeps a save history of your folder, so any change can be taken back.
outbound-check: Before anything leaves, checks it for passwords, account numbers, other people's names and your address.
weekly-brief: One page on your week: what came in, what went out, and the dates ahead.
update: Pulls new skills and tools from the public repo. Never touches your files.

headlines.Reading the web: Reads the web, even behind logins
headlines.Video and audio: Turns video and audio into text, and converts the files
headlines.Documents: Reads your documents and makes new ones
headlines.Images: Finds photos with the rights recorded, and sorts your own
headlines.Research: Answers a question from many sources, with receipts
headlines.Keeping the workspace honest: Looks after itself and stays current
headlines.More: Added since this page was written
